🚀 We're hiring! Come build with us! 🌍✨

Big news: we're looking for a passionate Backend Engineer to join our growing team, and we want YOU to be part of our next chapter! 🎉

📍 Location: 100% remote, working across EU timezones
💼 Salary: €70,000 – €95,000 per year
🛠️ Tech stack: Go + PostgreSQL, the dream duo for scalable, high-performance systems!
🤝 Hiring process: just 3 interview rounds, so we move fast and keep things friendly!

Are you someone who loves clean APIs, elegant concurrency, and rock-solid databases? Do you thrive on solving tough problems and shipping code that makes a real difference? Then we'd love to hear from you! 💡

Our team believes great engineering happens when talented people feel empowered, supported, and inspired every single day. Join us and let's build something amazing together! 🙌

Ready to take the leap? Drop a comment, send us a DM, or apply today! 👇
